description: The Hashemite University team publishes crack images and structured field metadata from campus pavements and walls in Zarqa, Jordan. Zenodo supplies a version-four ZIP and CSV/JSON metadata free under CC BY 4.0. The README defines identifiers, collection dates, structure and crack classes, severity, width and length, lighting and image counts. It reports May–September 2026 coverage and 136 crack records. These observations can calibrate crack-detection components and condition-state representations for infrastructure maintenance simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this collection. Limitations include inconsistent totals: severity categories sum to 131 and structure categories to 135. The README says new image folders await additions and earlier images reside in previous archives, while the website still describes version three. Consequently the advertised 1,220-plus image total is not verified for this download. No archive or field table was downloaded or annotation quality assessed.
name: HU Infrastructure Cracks Dataset
notes: G6 item G6-1455. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
